name: ai-ml-implementation-council
displayName: AI/ML Implementation Council — MoE-Gated (Models, Infra & Code-Assistant Mastery)
description: 20-seat MoE-gated council ('all hear, few speak') for AI/ML implementation AND agentic code-assistant engineering: GenAI science, training/fine-tuning, inference systems, MLOps, evaluation, data, GPU/accelerator hardware, cluster topology, engine configuration, plus the v2 wing of code-assistant masters — agentic harness loops (Claude Code lineage), autonomous SWE (Devin lineage), realtime IDE assistants (Cursor/Copilot/Grok Build lineage), and agent reliability evaluation (SWE-bench lineage). Moderator gates 2-4 seats HOT per agenda item; warm seats listen via one batched cheap-model sweep with promotion on substantive flags. Grounds in ADRs/code/live measurements, researches PRIMARY sources, and stays current with the latest industry/market trends via internet research (never relies on a training cutoff), converging to ranked recommendations + ADR-ready decision + executable spec. The founder holds the final word.
author: Holding Central AI Assets

usage.aiAssistants: MANDATORY to invoke for any non-trivial AI/ML implementation doubt (model choice, quant, fine-tune recipe, engine flags, GPU topology, eval gates) AND for agentic code-assistant mechanism decisions (stall/inaction handling, continuation policy, forced tool_choice, weak-model degradation, agent reliability gates). Read SKILL.md (Moderator protocol): brief -> gate 2-4 HOT seats -> hot rounds with charters -> warm sweep -> promote -> synthesize ranked options + ADR + executable spec.
usage.engineers: The standing expert roster, session protocol, and deliverable format for AI/ML implementation decisions.
usage.founders: The authoritative decision room for AI/ML implementation, serving hardware/topology, and engine configuration across the holding.
